description:
This image features a whimsical cake adorned with a fondant cow figurine, set against a serene outdoor backdrop.

The cake's square base is wrapped in green fondant, while the top is covered in purple fondant, with a small portion extending over the sides. A red barn facade is painted on the side of the cake, complete with a white door and a red cross. The fondant cow, positioned on top of the cake, boasts a pink coat with orange spots and a pink hat
